acceptance: TPC-DS Stream Load sends file bytes without per-line Python rewriting.
Decimal NULL handling and row counts match current behavior.
description: doris.py:560-563 and :596-610 apply _fix_tpcds_decimal_nulls to every line of TPC-DS files and re-encode them; the non-chunked path reads the whole file into memory. Use Doris load options (columns: header with ifnull/mappings) or pyarrow.csv preprocessing. The executemany fallback at doris.py:633-676 runs only when requests is missing; consider making requests required and removing it.
